conventions.pos_in: inches in scene axes: x along the wall from its right end as seen from the yard, y out from the wall face, z up from the ground
conventions.heading_deg: compass style about z: 0 looks out along +y, 90 along +x, 180 faces the wall
conventions.roll_deg: turn about the view axis, positive when the top of the phone turns right as the holder sees it
